title: Unit Event — Cheer With My Heart! — Episode3 An Earnest Dream

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! has received an invitation to the Lumina Grand Prix, an idol TV program organized by Ms. Arisawa. At the orientation, the legendary idol speaks of the idea of a "true idol", which resonates with Airi.

rows.Line: The next day
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wow...! I don't think any of us realized the Lumina Grand Prix would be such a big competition.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we were also surprised.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the scale of the program, as well as the number of entrants. Also, the thought that went into it. Everything went beyond our expectations...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The thought that went into it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Ms. Arisawa said it herself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Idols can become the light that helps people move forward during tough times.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And she wants us to shine for them on this program!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So that they can move forward...
That goes perfectly with what you've all been trying to do as idols.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, that's why we decided to enter.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. Personally, a lot of the things Ms. Arisawa said really hit home with me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Personally? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... There really were a lot of things, but the part that resonated with me the most was her story about what it means to have an idol's heart.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because I've always wanted to have heart and give hope to as many people as I can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You have been saying that for as long as I can remember, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Come to think of it, why is that?
What made you focus on having heart?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna ask the same question!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well, in that case...
I think it's story time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It would've been when I was still a third grader.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wanted to dazzle everyone like the idols I saw on TV...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I decided to start working towards becoming an idol myself.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
What do you think? Does it suit me?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, you look adorable!
It even makes you seem a little more grown-up.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Light blue is in right now, so I tried adding that for a more grown-up combination!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
And this pleated skirt is key too!
The hem's a little short, so it...elongates my legs, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Where did you learn that...?
You must've been studying fashion quite a bit lately.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Yup! That's because idols need to look fashionable and stylish!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, Mom, I wanna ask a favor.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: A favor?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I want you to let me audition for something!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Wait, audition for what...?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I heard that they're forming a sister group for Afternoon Girls.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: And I wanna try to become a member!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, Afternoon Girls...?
They're the group that's been on TV quite a lot lately, yes? Aren't they incredibly popular?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! That's why being a member of their sister group would mean getting to appear on TV and put on a lot of shows.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Also, I really like the concept they came up with for this group!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, they've already come up with a concept?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Yup! Everyone in Afternoon Girls is really cool and mature, so this group's gonna be more cute and cheerful.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: And their goal is gonna be to make all of Japan smile! Just like my dream!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: That's right. The agency also seems reputable, so I don't have a problem with you auditioning for them.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, but... Before you go ahead with this, there's something I need to ask you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Ask me...?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: There are countless others just like you out there who look up to idols and want to become one...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Auditioning for this group means competing against them. Do you understand that?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I do...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: If I want to be chosen, then I'm gonna have to start practicing harder than ever.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Yes. However, that doesn't mean you're allowed to let your grades slip. Do you promise to work hard in both respects?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
I promise...!
I'll start getting even higher grades on my tests!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Because... I really want to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: So, please...!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: I believe in you, Airi, so I'm going to give you all the support I can. Let's do our best on this audition!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Mom...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Thanks! You're the best!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Aren't I?
Anyway, let's start by finding more information about this audition, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Okay! Let's see... The first step is to send in an application and have them review it...
A few weeks later
Park

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (They passed my application...!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I'm glad Mom and I worked so hard coming up with answers to those questions!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (But I can't let my guard down, since I still have to pass the second round...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I've gotta sing and dance in a way that totally blows the judges away!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
I'll start by practicing my dance moves.
One, two, three...
se_walk_men_001_4

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line:
Hey, check it out.
The monster's dancing.

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully A
rows.Line: Whoa, you're right. And why are you wearing a skirt?! You look so stupid in that thing.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
Nobody asked you!
I'm allowed to wear whatever I want!

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully B
rows.Line:
Wait, you made her mad!
We gotta run before she starts hitting us!
se_run_men_001_4

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I'm not hitting anyone!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Hmph...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (They haven't changed a bit since we were little.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (Are they still bitter about the way I punished them for picking on my little sister?)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (But what they say doesn't matter right now...!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
Now, where was I?
One, two, three, four...
